lines: Organizes 2 tabs with 3 rules — currently: MACHINES and SPARES.

STATUS stages, in order: IN-PROCESS (labels containing “PROCESS”), COMPLETED (labels containing “COMPLET”), DISPUTED (labels containing “DISPUT”), DISPATCHED (labels containing “DISPATCH”) and CANCELLED (labels containing “CANCEL”); any other label sorts last with plain formatting.

1. Keep every tab with a STATUS column (currently: MACHINES and SPARES) sorted by STATUS stage (in the order shown under Stages) then by DISPATCH DATE, oldest first, blanks last (whenever STATUS, DISPATCH DATE or FREEZE? is edited).
2. Color rows in every tab with a STATUS column (currently: MACHINES and SPARES) (right after rule 1 runs).
- Each row starts as black text, no fill; the rules below are applied in order, and a later match wins.
- Where STATUS is IN-PROCESS: red text.
- Where STATUS is COMPLETED: green text.
- Where STATUS is DISPUTED: gold text.
- Where STATUS is CANCELLED: black text, struck through.
- Where STATUS is IN-PROCESS and DISPATCH DATE is before today (overdue): black text on pink.
- In the FREEZE? column, cells that are “YES”: green text.
3. Rebuild the SUMMARY tab from every tab with a STATUS column (currently: MACHINES and SPARES) (2 minutes after edits stop).
- Columns are lined up by name across tabs.
- A “SOURCE SHEET” column comes first, holding the source tab's name.
- Empty “Type of Work” cells are filled with the source tab's name.
- Sorted the same way as rule 1.
- Colored the same way as rule 2.
- Title banner: “CONSOLIDATED ORDER SUMMARY — ALL SHEETS”.
- Locked against manual edits (it is rebuilt automatically).
Rows with “!hold” set are never touched.
A run that would change more than 500 rows is stopped before writing anything.
If a header in a governed tab is renamed, the sheet pauses instead of running rules.
